description: Verse Engine by Ctruh is a browser-native 3D engine that turns 3D files, scans and floor plans into one link. Learn how it works and how to start.

docs.article:
GETTING STARTED / WHAT IS VERSE ENGINE?

What is Verse Engine?

Verse Engine by Ctruh turns a 3D file, a Blender, Unity or Unreal project, or a floor plan into one link that opens in any modern browser. There’s no app to install for you or your viewers.

Verse Engine by Ctruh is made by Ctruh. It is different from VersaAI, Ctruh's AI for creating 3D models, and from Ctruh Studio. Learn more about Ctruh

It’s Ctruh’s own engine, built for the browser. It uses WebGPU where available and falls back to WebGL2, and streams only what each viewer can see, so large scenes open quickly on phones as well as laptops.

Ways to bring a scene

  • Upload a file in Studio (20+ formats, up to 20 GB on paid plans)
  • Publish from the Blender, Unity or Unreal plug-in
  • Send a floor plan to get a walkable, furnished home
  • Upload through the REST API
cURL
BASE=https://verse.ctruh.com

curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/v1/ingest" \
  -H "Content-Type: model/gltf-binary" \
  -H "X-Verse-Name: my-apartment" \
  --data-binary @scene.glb
